parameters.query:
SELECT party_id, party_code, status, restaurant_name, tip_percent,
       subtotal_required, subtotal_claimed, bucket_empty,
       subtotal_match, party_can_pay, remaining_value_cents
FROM party_validation_view
WHERE party_id = $1::uuid

SELECT
  i.id, i.name, i.unit_price_cents, i.total_quantity,
  COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity), 0)                        AS claimed_quantity,
  i.total_quantity - COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity), 0)     AS remaining_quantity
FROM items i
LEFT JOIN selections s ON s.item_id = i.id
WHERE i.party_id = $1::uuid
GROUP BY i.id
ORDER BY i.created_at

SELECT
  g.id, g.display_name, g.role, g.status, g.user_id,
  COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity * i.unit_price_cents), 0)   AS subtotal_cents,
  p.tip_percent,
  COALESCE(pay.amount_paid_cents, 0)                   AS amount_paid_cents
FROM guests g
JOIN parties p ON p.id = g.party_id
LEFT JOIN selections s ON s.guest_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN items i ON i.id = s.item_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_paid_cents), 0) AS amount_paid_cents
  FROM payments WHERE guest_id = g.id
) pay ON TRUE
WHERE g.party_id = $1::uuid
GROUP BY g.id, g.display_name, g.role, g.status, g.user_id, p.tip_percent, pay.amount_paid_cents
ORDER BY g.created_at

SELECT s.guest_id, s.item_id, s.quantity
FROM selections s
JOIN items i ON i.id = s.item_id
WHERE i.party_id = $1::uuid
